name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Centenarian
nodalDept: Contact the official scheme portal for details
targetBeneficiaries: Institutions/organizations rendering distinguished service for the cause of elderly persons
briefDescription: This central scheme confers awards on eminent senior citizens and institutions/organizations for their distinguished service towards the elderly, especially indigent seniors. Awards are presented annually by the President of India.
descriptionMd: The National Award For Senior Citizens, known as Vayoshreshtha Samman, recognizes and honors exemplary contributions. It celebrates both individual senior citizens and organizations dedicated to improving the lives of the elderly. This initiative aims to acknowledge and encourage service for the cause of senior citizens, particularly those who are indigent.
benefitsMd:
- Recognition as an eminent and outstanding senior citizen or institution/organization.
- Conferment of the award by the Hon’ble President of India.
- Acknowledgement for distinguished service for the cause of elderly persons.
eligibilityMd:
- Must be an eminent and outstanding senior citizen.
- Must be an institution/organization rendering distinguished service for the cause of elderly persons.
- Special consideration for service to indigent senior citizens.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
